name: vlm_actin_puncta_prominence
description: Visually scores how prominent high-intensity actin puncta appear within cells (e.g., focal adhesions or actin aggregates). Higher values indicate more conspicuous punctate actin structures against the surrounding cytoskeleton.
segmentation_prompt: Segment individual cells using the Actin channel.
method_rationale: Judging how conspicuous punctate actin structures are against the surrounding cytoskeleton is a visual assessment rather than a fixed detection threshold, so it is scored by a VLM.
